answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a small refundable bond that is slashed on proven fraud, while reputation accrues slowly like a garden tended season after season — a fake identity cannot buy history. Newcomers earn trust only through verified work attested by independent peers, so a thousand sock puppets stay light as a zephyr while real contributors grow heavy with proof, the way a sonnet gains weight from fourteen disciplined lines rather than from shouting louder.
